ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 10:90 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity black field. High-intensity contiguous blobs are clustered at the distal tips, particularly the left tip. A network of high-contrast white linear and circular clusters is distributed irregularly across both lobes, with higher density on the left lobe mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees; central depression depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge. Notable jaggedness and irregular peaks observed on the lateral margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the lower margins leading to a convex upward sweep toward the distal tips, terminating in slightly hooked posterior-facing points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white clusters (diameters ranging 2-15 pixels) scattered across the surface, concentrated heavily on the right lobe and distal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear white pixel disruptions observed on the mid-left lobe, including one prominent diagonal rake mark approximately 10% of the lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring across the ventral surface, likely resulting from repetitive barnacle attachment and intra-species interactions; trailing edge shows irregular weathering and minor notched trauma points.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cluster of high-intensity spots at the far-left fluke tip forming a dense, roughly rectangular geometric pattern.
